complicacoes.texto: Not satisfied to remain little more than a brain in a jar, the Brain is constantly pursuing every possible avenue, no matter how unlikely or risky, to acquire a new body for himself. This has led him to seek out everything from robotic chassis his brain can be interred in to clones that can likewise house his Intelecto.

The Brain requires his cybernetic housing to survive e provide rudimentary sensory input. Even within the housing, the Brain suffers from reduced mobility, as his housing’s Habilidade to move e maneuver are extremely Limitado, e he is unable to directly manipulate his Ambiente. The housing is roughly 3 ft. 4 in. tall e weighs about 195 libras.

The Brain e Monsieur Mallah are involved in a romantic relationship that can, at best, be described as extraordinarily unorthodox given former’s disembodied circumstances e Mallah being a mutated gorilla.
